messages:
alice: Heads-up: promo is stuck on deploybot due to a cache restore timeout in the CI job. Change window is 16:00 UTC. We need a quick decision: pin to last-good or wait for rerun?
ben: saw the logs, cache restore 504 -> retry loop. deploybot is throttling promote attempts because of repeated failures.
maya: can we pin to digest? which image is last-good?
ian: last-good for this PR is registry/redwood/service@sha256:abc123def. Pin would be fastest to unblock.
alice: ok @ian do we have a safe rollback patch? any migration tied to this release?
ian: no migrations. Only a tiny config flag. Pin is safe.
ben: +1 to pin. But we should also try a rerun to see if cache recovers before manual promote. If rerun fails, we pin.
maya: fine. schedule: I'll kick a rerun now. (bk run pipeline --job cd-deploy --commit abc123)
ci-bot: pipeline cd-deploy started (id: 75421). cache: restoring from s3://redwood-cache/sha256/abcdef...
deploybot: Promote attempt blocked: throttle backoff (3 consecutive failures). Next allow at 3333333200. Manual promote requires approvals.
ben: rerun looks stuck on the same s3 GET 504 after ~45s. log snippet: ```HTTP GET https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-cache/abcdef -> 504 Gateway Timeout```
alice: if rerun same error in 5m we manually pin. We need release notes check too	7 did PM update the notes?
maya: @alice I just checked the release notes doc, two small UX bullets added. I'll paste the snippets to the release_notes branch after pin.
ian: to pin: we need to update the deploy manifest to use image digest, and then push promo. Who can approve manual promote?
alice: @ben can you approve if i create the PR? I'm on the change window shadow.
ben: yes. But remember we need to notify support/ops: manual promote bypasses some automated canary steps.
deploybot: manual promote requested by alice for commit abc123.
deploybot: approval needed from reviewers: ben, ian.
ben: approved. ian: approved.
ben: doing the manifest patch: ```- image: registry/redwood/service:latest
+ image: registry/redwood/service@sha256:abc123def```
ci-bot: manifest-validate job passed. canary deploy will still run but with pin.
maya: pushing release notes now, adding the UX bullets + known issue about CI cache flakiness.
alice: thanks. After canary passes we ship to prod. Also followup action: open ticket to investigate S3 cache 504s and deploybot throttle sensitivity.
ian: created RED-1256: investigate cache s3 timeouts + backoff tuning.
ben: leaving a note in changelog: manual pin used to unblock due to infra flake.
alice: :thumbsup: to everyone for quick turnaround.
ci-bot: canary finished: all checks green. deploybot: promotion queued and now processed successfully. Release window still on.
alice: closing thread. I'll update release checklist with the manual-pin entry.
